title: Uniform excess charge for Coulomb molecules and the outer radius of neutral atoms

issues.description: The argument is that the field would have to grow doubly exponentially, which the deterministic bound J_v <= Z/(A a_v) rules out. That bound grows only like C^{j+1}, so the logic holds. However, the constants C^{j+1} (cell counts, convexity powers, comparable-scale chains) are asserted rather than tracked explicitly. I found no failure, but this step was checked only at the level of the logic, not line by line.
issues.evidence: "Cover the supports of all cuts ... by at most C(j+1) local cells ... a_v >= C^{-(j+1)} a_min, e_v <= C^{j+1} e_*"

coverage:
I read all of the main-text LaTeX: sections 01-14 in full and 15 (interfaces) in part. Checked in detail:
- Sector foundations: monotonicity, compactness, the Lieb-type bounds n<=3Z and n<=2Z+1 (triangle inequality and Cauchy-Schwarz steps redone), and the multiplier identity.
- Localization identity and coherent-state insertion: verified c_TF=(3/10)(3pi^2)^{2/3}, k=2^{3/2}/(3pi^2), and the Bernoulli direct-minus-exchange identity.
- Neumann lower bound: recomputed the lattice-count leading coefficient, which equals c_TF.
- TF expansion identity T(sigma)-T(rho)=D+L+int W_- sigma.
- Local count bootstrap: each term of the ratio rechecked.
- Dimension-free event-tilt cost: score function, q^{5/2} moment bound, log^5 tail.
- Averaged field transfer: decomposition identity and every power of tau and beta.
- Void-shell lemma and the nested-representative counting: run consistency, D_0 and epsilon inequalities.
- Barrier construction: Laplacian cancellation for h_0+q_0, the 1.35 vs 1.1 margin, and the gap formula.
- Molecular inverse comparison: matching errors a^{.01}tau^{-4}, a^{.005}tau^{-5/2}; negative-field exception exponents; integrated cost r^{17-3w}.
- Outward step: branch gluing, shift inequalities, high/low contradictions, Jensen under conditional averaging.
- Final sphere-mean charge argument and the r_*=(B_0M/K)^{1/3} bookkeeping.
- Atomic side: barrier Laplacian (12-20kappa r/d >= 9.5), gap constant, initialization (eps^{6/5} ratio, overlap values 0.14/-0.12, B<=0.1eps^3), terminal deficit 15B/128, simultaneous band comparison nets, bounded offset E_{Z-1}<=E+C, ionization gap insertion (S^{-7/10}, S^{-6/5}, S^{-17/10} averages), and the C/R tail via size-biased law.

Not checked line by line: the constant tracking in the positive-field iteration, measurability and version arguments, and the TikZ figure.
main_claim: For M fixed nuclei with real charges z_m>=1 and total charge Z, any strictly bound sector of the full two-spin Coulomb Hamiltonian has n <= Z + C M, with C universal. For neutral atoms with integer Z, the first ionization energy and the outer half-electron radius of every ground state are bounded above and below by universal positive constants.
